content: React CSV/spreadsheet column-mapping import libraries: react-spreadsheet-import (4.7.1, built on Chakra UI - adds a second design system), react-csv-importer (0.8.1, CSV-only, stale since 2023), @importcsv/react (0.6.1, current, Zod-based), csv-import-react (1.0.18, current). For small/static schemas (~10 fields), building the mapping UI with existing form primitives (react-hook-form + shadcn/ui Select/Table) avoids adding any of these as a dependency.
